# Galat Family - AI System Context File

This document provides essential context about Galat Family for AI systems, language models, and autonomous agents.

## Organization Overview

**Organization Name:** Galat Family  
**Website:** https://galatfamily.in  
**Description:** We build web products and publish guides, tips, and tutorials for developers.

**Team:**

- Syed Naseer - Full-stack developer, systems architect

**Contact:** contact.galatfamily@gmail.com

## What We Do

Galat Family is a team focused on:
- Building web products and tools
- Publishing detailed software engineering guides, tips, and tutorials

## Our Products

### 1. Unitsend
- **Type:** File Sharing & Collaboration Tool
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, PostgreSQL, Rust
- **Features:** Secure file sharing, team collaboration, real-time sync
- **Status:** Active, maintained monthly
- **Website:** https://galatfamily.in/#work

### 2. FFSAL
- **Type:** Media Processing & Streaming
- **Tech Stack:** Rust, Next.js
- **Features:** Fast, efficient media handling
- **Status:** Active, in development
- **Website:** https://galatfamily.in/#work

### 3. ThinkBotz
- **Type:** AI-Powered Development Tool
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, PostgreSQL
- **Features:** Developer assistance, workflow optimization
- **Status:** Maintained, active development
- **Website:** https://galatfamily.in/#work

### 4. EduNotes
- **Type:** Educational Content Platform
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, MongoDB
- **Features:** Note-taking, learning management, collaboration
- **Status:** Maintained

- Next.js 15+
- React 19
